c54321957.notes: Old cast street plate (raised letters, tilted) and a separate house-number plate '302' on a crumbling wall in Santiago de Cuba; dark, low-contrast photo. The street plate shows only 'PADRE P' (calle Padre Pico per the source). Small 'dani2010 copyright ©' credit bottom right.

c54347564.notes: Carved wooden guitar-shaped sign of the Casa de la Trova in Sancti Spíritus, hanging in a blue doorway. The initial C of 'Casa' is formed by the guitar-body outline, so the letters read 'asa de la trova'. Small 'dani2010 copyright ©' credit bottom right.

c77022424.notes: Stone corner marker (guardacantón) on a Havana sidewalk with stencilled street names on its faces: MARINO on the front, TULIPAN (no accent painted) on the right face; the I's are stencilled with a dot. A third face in shadow at left repeats a name rotated and is not reliably legible. Seen from above.

c58939176.notes: Small dark-framed street plate 'AGUIAR' with an octagonal house-number plate '152' below, on a corner building in Old Havana; plates are small in frame. Distractors: faded painted sign at right ('CAFE ALMA', 'COMIDA Y BEBIDAS', with an arched top line that looks like 'PRECIOS ECONOMICOS' but is not clearly legible), faint ghost lettering left of the door, 'RON' roundel, and a vegetable cart with people.

c38440921.notes: Large painted plank billboard at Cienfuegos airport with a drawing of the terminal; GONZALEZ painted without accent. Palm fronds touch the final S of CIENFUEGOS. Bust on a plinth in front.

c109328331.notes: Illuminated paladar sign at night in Cienfuegos with a green iguana, red arrow header and LED 'OPEN' sign below. The small script 'Tony y Maylin' is hard to read (the second name could be 'Maylín'), and the arrow text is small. Faint 'LOS DELFINES HOSTAL' sign at right is a distractor.

c1528720.notes: Municipal welcome monument on a roundabout in Boyeros, Havana: red letters BOYEROS on a beam above a model aircraft, with SALUDA in red letters behind it. Shot from a moving vehicle through glass. Oro Negro petrol station canopy and a blue keep-left sign are distractors.

c131793051.notes: Blue 3D letters on a white beam at the municipal border of Encrucijada (Villa Clara), among royal palms; shot through a car window, slight blur.
